summary: Frontend-only verification of Fixed Assets edit & deliver-to-store flow on /fixed-assets. Logged in as admin on general-union, opened the page, verified edit & deliver-store buttons exist in the row, verified edit mode (title changes to 'تعديل أصل ثابت', data pre-fills, 'حفظ التعديلات' and 'إلغاء التعديل' buttons appear), and verified deliver-to-store flow: confirm dialog handled via auto-accept, asset removed from table, success toast 'تم تسليم الأصل للمخازن وإزالة قيمته من جميع الحسابات' displayed, totals became 0.
critical_code_review_comments: Note: the pre-existing test asset in general-union had cost 75000 (not 50000 as described in the task) at the time of testing — likely leftover from a previous iteration. The edit UI mechanics (title change, prefill, cancel/save buttons) all verified correctly, but the save round-trip (changing cost and verifying new value in table) was NOT re-executed because the asset was then deleted by the deliver-to-store step. The backend PUT /api/fixed-assets/{id} was already verified by main agent per handoff note.
seed_data_creation: None. Used the pre-existing test asset which was then deleted by deliver-to-store as expected.
context_for_next_testing_agent: If re-testing is needed, create a new asset first via UI, since deliver-to-store deleted the single test asset. All data-testid selectors (fixed-asset-create-title, fixed-asset-save-button, fixed-asset-cancel-edit-button, fixed-assets-table, row-level *-edit-button and *-deliver-store-button) are in place and working. window.confirm must be handled via page.on('dialog', d.accept()).
